description: This Java source file defines the 'HardcodedColorDetector' class, which is a lint detector to identify and flag hardcoded color values in Android resource XML files. It performs a two-phase check to detect direct and indirect hardcoded colors in layout, style, and drawable resource files, and promotes the use of theme attributes over fixed color values.

classes.name: HardcodedColorDetector
classes.description: A lint detector class that checks for hardcoded color values in Android XML resources. Implements logic to identify direct and indirect hardcoded color attributes and style elements, reporting errors when such patterns are found.

methods.name: appliesTo
methods.description: Determines if the detector applies to the given resource folder type. Applies to layout, values, and drawable folders.

methods.name: getApplicableAttributes
methods.description: Returns all attribute names in scope for this detector, which are intended to be checked.

methods.name: getApplicableElements
methods.description: Returns the set of element tags (style and color) that the detector should process.

methods.name: visitAttribute
methods.description: Analyzes individual attributes in XML files to detect hardcoded color values and indirect references.

methods.name: visitElement
methods.description: Analyzes style and color XML elements to detect hardcoded color values.

methods.name: afterCheckProject
methods.description: Runs after completing the project check; reports indirect color references that are hardcoded.

methods.name: isHardcodedColor
methods.description: Utility method to check if a color string is a hardcoded color hex value.

methods.name: addIndirectColor
methods.description: Stores references to colors that are indirectly hardcoded for later reporting.
